design_history.event: v1 pre-registration drafted: fixed-spread B0, GLFT B1, an overlay that shifts the GLFT quote centre
v1 fails canary C2 on the validation days: the oracle loses to B1, so that harness cannot turn information into PnL
v2 chosen by Ilia Duda before any test-day download: quote at the touch, step back on the side the signal marks toxic
C1 pass rule revised after C1 failed against B1: C1 is judged against R1, random pulls at C1's rate
Settings, thresholds, s and the MDE filled in from committed results
Run-length controls RL_B3 and RL_B2b added (exploratory)
Fill-hold control F added (exploratory), its hold rule committed before F ran
F's hold chosen on the training days: 0.1 s
Wording settled: no-print fills (section 3), selectivity (section 8), canary intervals (section 10), intervals that disagree (section 11)
C3 flag revised after the M5 dress rehearsal showed it firing on noise
Tag prereg-v1 created and pushed by Ilia Duda

note: Replay simulation of historical Binance BTCUSDT perpetual data: simulated fills, no order sent to an exchange, no claim about live trading or profit. Training and validation days only; test-day values are null.

The Hawkes overlay did worse than a decay-weighted trade count by X bp, interval [L, U].
The signal's gain does not depend on event signs, so it is not order-flow information. Primary result reported but not interpreted.
